clips.title: The story
paras: At Maestra's Post, Feero Ironhand guards the road between Darkshore and Ashenvale. He works with Delgren the Purifier against the Cult of the Dark Strand.

Maestra's Post watches the road south from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Feero Ironhand serves at the outpost, keeping communication and trade with Auberdine moving while watching the surrounding woods. He and Delgren the Purifier oppose the Cult of the Dark Strand. Cultists and forest predators threaten the path between Darnassus's supply lines and Ashenvale's front lines.
